name: Alpha Wolf
storyline: On the night Danya proposes to Alisa, Regent Saret ambushes the couple, abducts her and uses the stolen Lunar Sickle to transform Danya into a wolf. Guided by Sister Violetta, he sets out across the Valley of Seven Stars toward the Obsidian Citadel. The Regent's magical fog has bent the valley's inhabitants to his will. By defeating its guardians and breaking their enchantment with his howl, the Alpha Wolf gains unlikely allies on his journey to rescue Alisa.
summary: Alpha Wolf is a single-player 2D action platformer set in a steampunk dark fantasy world, with hand-drawn anime-style visuals. Players fight with a greatsword, a knife and a drivable tank, navigate platforming challenges, and face bosses with distinct mechanics. Defeated bosses can be freed from mind control and become allies who offer upgrades and services in the hub. The game combines a story-driven campaign with adult character comedy.
